AP_ELITE_STRENGTH.title: Elite Strength
AP_ELITE_STRENGTH.description: Elites and bosses start each combat with 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
AP_RANDOM_ENEMY_BUFFS.title: Random Enemy Buffs
AP_RANDOM_ENEMY_BUFFS.description: Every enemy starts combat with one random buff: 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], 4 [gold]Plating[/gold], 2 [gold]Thorns[/gold], 1 [gold]Artifact[/gold], 3 [gold]Regen[/gold], 4 [gold]Curl Up[/gold], 4 [gold]Vigor[/gold] or 1 [gold]Slippery[/gold].
AP_WEAKER_RESTS.title: Weaker Rests
AP_WEAKER_RESTS.description: Resting heals 25% of your Max HP instead of 30%.
AP_SLOW_START.title: Slow Start
AP_SLOW_START.description: Draw 1 fewer card on the first turn of each combat.
AP_FRAIL_START.title: Frail Start
AP_FRAIL_START.description: Start the run with 10% less Max HP.
AP_EXTRA_ASCENDERS_BANE.title: Extra Ascender's Bane
AP_EXTRA_ASCENDERS_BANE.description: Start the run with an extra [gold]Ascender's Bane[/gold].
